steps.method: DESeq2 blind VST sample structure QC (library sizes, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap)
minimal pre-filter: keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least the smallest group size

GSVA per-sample pathway scores on the variance-stabilized matrix, tested between groups with limma
structured report with reproducibility record, fit diagnostics, and per-collection enrichment metadata
